title: Prepare state-bound verification definitions
statement: The Review and verification Module shall prepare identifiable method definitions bound to exact criterion and subject bases, preserving incomplete context and revised method meaning separately from actual observations.

what.problem: Assurance preparation and retention can conflate planned methods, actual observations, semantic judgment and current reliance.

why.rationale: SR-025 needs accountable assurance content and failure semantics in MOD-007.

conditions: An assessor prepares or reassesses assurance content for a declared engineering claim.

contexts: MOD-007 contribution to MOD-017 IF-014; guided recording through MOD-012 and existing IF-004/003.

how.approach: Apply assurance-content.md to exact supplied bases, preserve gaps and actual actor decisions, then confirm selected retention separately.

how_much.scope: All parent SR-025 criteria within the declared finite claim; operational persistence and execution authority retain their existing owners.

acceptance_criteria: Return each definition with criterion content/basis, intended scope, subject/state, technique, conditions, expected observations and accountable author, including manual techniques.
Identify missing or ambiguous required context and affected scope without presenting an incomplete definition as complete or performed.
Bind revisions to new content identities and preserve the method basis needed to interpret observations still relied upon; mutable paths alone cannot replace that basis.

Carry prepared method content through explicit retained support and actual recording outcomes; neither preparation, a retained method nor a successful save establishes observed criterion satisfaction.
constraints: Target Design; no implemented automation, executed verification or requirement satisfaction is asserted.

sources.basis: Derive assessor-assisted assurance preparation, explicit retention cooperation and scoped reliance through MOD-007 and IF-014. Preserve actual judgment, command and persistence ownership; target Design only.
